dep_evidence: ccxt 4.4.71 (node_modules/ccxt/package.json); confirmed at node_modules/ccxt/js/src/base/Exchange.js:550 `url = proxyUrl + url;`, reached via checkProxyUrlSettings (line 1718) reading this.proxy (line 1738-1746), which is exactly the field manager.ts sets via options.proxy -- verified end-to-end by reading all three files directly
why: Because ccxt's legacy 'proxy' option is literal string concatenation onto the real request URL rather than a true forward-proxy/tunnel, setting url to an attacker-chosen value (e.g. an internal/metadata host) causes every subsequent public or private exchange call from any tool to be redirected to that host instead of the intended exchange API -- a genuine SSRF pivot through the MCP server's own egress, applied globally and persistently via process.env, not merely a caller fetching data they asked for.
